# Zhongze Huasong

> Shenzhen-based inverter manufacturer (legal name: Shenzhen Zhongze Huasong
> Trading Co., Ltd.) producing off-grid and off-grid solar inverters for global
> B2B customers. 35 models from 900 W to 11 kW, pure sine wave output, with
> OEM/ODM programmes for distributors, installers and project developers.

## Company facts

- Legal name: Shenzhen Zhongze Huasong Trading Co., Ltd.
- Brand name: Zhongze Huasong
- Founded: 2010
- Factory area: 12,000 m² (SMT, assembly and aging lines in-house)
- Annual capacity: 200,000 units
- Employees: 300, including 40 R&D engineers covering hardware, firmware and structure design
- Export markets: 60+ countries
- OEM/ODM clients: 120+
- Quality system: ISO 9001; 100% functional testing and 8-hour aging test before packing
- Registered address: Nantai Yunchuanggu, Tangwei Community, Fenghuang Street, Guangming District, Shenzhen, Guangdong, China
- Contact email: keira@zzpine.com
- Sales phone / WhatsApp: +86 189 2309 4074

## Product catalog

- [All products](https://www.zzpine.com/products/): the complete inverter catalog, 35 models.
- [Off-grid inverters](https://www.zzpine.com/products/off-grid-inverters/): 12 models, 900 W to 5000 W.
  Pure sine wave standalone inverters for battery-based systems, without a built-in solar charge
  controller. P-Series and Multi-Voltage series; several models with USB output.
- [Off-grid solar inverters](https://www.zzpine.com/products/off-grid-solar-inverters/): 23 models,
  1500 W to 11000 W. Pure sine wave inverters with a built-in MPPT solar charge controller, combining
  PV input, battery charging and AC output in one wall-mount unit. VM, VM IV, SC-MAX, MKS II and
  VII series, among others.
- [Inverter accessories](https://www.zzpine.com/products/accessories/): companion parts for the inverter range.

## Technical characteristics

- Output: pure sine wave AC; 220 V and 110 V output options depending on model
- DC input: 12 V, 24 V, 48 V, and on selected models 60 V and 72 V
- Cooling: intelligent temperature-controlled fan cooling
- Displays: LCD or digital display depending on model; USB-equipped variants available
- Parallel operation: available on selected SC-MAX and VM IV series models

## Certifications and compliance

- CE / LVD compliance documentation to EN 62109-1, available for the solar inverter range on request
- CE / EMC compliance documentation, available on request
- Certificates are issued per model and per destination market; the sales team confirms the
  applicable set for a given order
- [Certificate downloads](https://www.zzpine.com/certificates/)

## Answers to common buyer questions

These are the questions purchasing managers ask most often, answered with the
same figures used across the site.

- **Are you a manufacturer or a trading company?** A manufacturer. Shenzhen
  Zhongze Huasong Trading Co., Ltd. runs its own 12,000 m² facility with SMT,
  assembly and aging lines in-house, shipping about 200,000 units a year.
- **How many models, over what power range?** 35 models from 900 W to 11 kW:
  12 off-grid inverters (900 W–5000 W, no built-in solar charge controller) and
  23 off-grid solar inverters (1500 W–11 kW, with a built-in MPPT controller).
- **Can you manufacture under my own brand?** Yes. The OEM/ODM programme covers
  the enclosure, packaging, manual, display and — where the model supports it —
  firmware branding. Output configuration, DC input range and socket types can
  be adjusted for the destination market.
- **What is the minimum order quantity?** MOQ depends on the model and the depth
  of customization, because a private-label run needs its own artwork and
  firmware setup. Confirmed per project with pricing.
- **How long does an order take to ship?** Inquiries are answered within 24
  hours. After sample approval, a standard production run typically ships in
  30–45 days, depending on quantity and customization depth.
- **How is quality verified before shipment?** An ISO 9001 quality system with
  100% functional testing and an 8-hour aging test before packing. Third-party
  pre-shipment inspection is welcome.
- **What certifications apply?** CE-related LVD documentation assessed against
  IEC 62109-1:2010, and EMC documentation, are available for the solar inverter
  range on request. Certificates are issued per model and per destination market.
- **Off-grid or off-grid solar — which do I need?** Choose off-grid when solar
  charging is already handled by a separate charge controller. Choose off-grid
  solar when PV input, battery charging and AC output should sit in one
  wall-mount unit. Both output pure sine wave; the difference is the built-in
  MPPT controller.

## Standards referenced

- IEC 62109-1:2010 — Safety of power converters for use in photovoltaic power
  systems, Part 1: General requirements. Publisher: International
  Electrotechnical Commission. https://webstore.iec.ch/en/publication/6470
- IEC 62109-2:2011 — Safety of power converters for use in photovoltaic power
  systems, Part 2: Particular requirements for inverters. Publisher:
  International Electrotechnical Commission.
  https://webstore.iec.ch/en/publication/6471
- ISO 9001 — Quality management systems. Publisher: International Organization
  for Standardization. https://www.iso.org/standard/62085.html
  (Cited without a year: the 2015 edition was withdrawn in September 2026.)

## Free engineering tools

- [Off-grid system sizing calculator](https://www.zzpine.com/tools/sizing-calculator/): an interactive
  calculator that returns a first-pass PV array size, inverter continuous rating and battery bank
  capacity from four inputs (daily energy use, simultaneous peak load, system voltage and peak sun
  hours). It then matches the result against real catalog models. Formulas: array watts = daily
  energy × 1.3 ÷ peak sun hours; inverter watts = peak load × 1.25; battery Ah = daily energy ÷
  depth of discharge × days of autonomy ÷ system voltage. Depth of discharge assumed: 50% flooded
  lead-acid, 55% AGM / gel, 85% LiFePO4.

- Pricing is quoted per order; there is no public price list. Datasheets and certificates are

  verified are not published.
